acceptanceCriteria: A live Playwright run with a stub routed then unrouted before any request records the stub as unrouted, not never-matched, with the browser tuple retained.
body: V1-1474 (PR #1412) fixed stub-never-matched for route stubs removed by unroute before any request, proven by fixture tests only. A live Playwright run under the qualified browser tuple is still missing.
title: Live Playwright qualification of LPCV-V0-214 unroute-before-request stub classification
